resources.string: B or Y: back to the app. Trigger: play or pause. A, X or grip: show or hide this panel. Right thumbstick left or right: previous or next media; up or down: 10 seconds forward or back in a video, a larger or smaller flat screen, or turn a photo by 90 degrees. Left thumbstick left or right: turn the view, hold it to keep turning, or bring a flat screen back in front; up or down: a flat screen farther or nearer.
